operator_notes: Tile 3 was HELD and tile 5 was ACTIVATED with a force at its centroid, which IS the boundary condition the design was optimised under (bc_clamped [3], load on face 5).
The cutting drawing's HOLD mark was known to be misplaced and was NOT followed; the correct tile was held.
The closed sheet is essentially perfectly closed and is a true 4 ft x 8 ft rectangle.
The red target rectangle was taped on the floor by hand and is the less precise of the two objects.
